data.body: debug-everything 2026-05-08: Investigated. This is upstream claude-code harness behavior, not a DSO plugin defect. The plugin's skills, agents, and hooks are correctly defined; whether they are registered at session start vs requiring /reload-plugins is owned by the harness's plugin loader. Confirmed via Anthropic engineering reference: known issues anthropics/claude-code#48963 (Plugin skills not appearing in / menu after v2.1.110) and anthropics/claude-code#37862 (/reload-plugins doesn't rebuild slash-command index). DSO cannot fix this from inside the plugin. ESCALATED — recommended actions: (1) file/upvote upstream issue with this session's reproducer, (2) optionally add a one-line note to host project CLAUDE.md instructing users to run /reload-plugins on session start as a workaround. jira-dig-1639 has identical title with empty description — likely Jira-mirror duplicate.
